title: 第7章 他的秘密 她的秘密
novel_title: 开局废灵根，成了宗门团宠小师叔
content_zh:
“胡三，她只是个凡人，五脏六腑均破灭，浑身筋脉尽断，救不了了。”

    “你还有办法的，对不对？”

    “有，但代价巨大，你付不起。”

    “……”

    原来，她又要死了吗？

    这是第几次了？

    第四次？还是第五次？

    记不清了。

    这一世也很累，要不就这样死去吧。

    她不再挣扎，放任自己坠入无边无际的黑暗。

    虚无，阴冷，压抑……

    像是被塞入了一个深井，又像是被塞入了一个冰窖。

    身体慢慢变得僵硬，无法动弹。

    忽然，一束光亮从她的头顶落下。

    她努力仰起头，眯眼看去。

    那光芒太过刺眼，她看不分明，却下意识地伸手。

    指尖触及到一片柔软，她几乎是本能地抓住。

    温暖，又灼热！

    像是燃烧的火焰，从指尖处破开，往身体里钻。

    好疼！

    巨大的疼痛，盖过了冰冷，盖过了麻木，也盖过了那片短暂的温暖，甚至驱逐了她的颓废和死意。

    头顶的光猛然落下，伴随着那股灼热窜入身体，如刀斧穿梭四肢百骸。

    她张口想要呼痛，却发现自己发不出一点声音。

    像是溺水的人，徒劳看着自己被吞噬。

    而木屋内，胡三却满目惊骇。

    桃夭悬浮在半空中，粉色的光芒从上方落下，将顾念念的身体完全笼罩后，又缓缓收缩，最终变成了一个粉色的光茧。

    周遭的灵气像是收到召唤一般，争先恐后地朝着光茧汇聚，没入。

    不过几个呼吸，方圆五里内的灵气已经全部被吸收一空。

    胡三眉眼一跳，意识到不对想要离开的时候，已经来不及了。

    一道光束从桃夭的剑身上飞了出来，直接锁住了胡三，将他拖到了光茧前。

    下一秒，身体里的灵力像是被开了一个巨大的口子，倾泻而出。

    胡三挣扎不得，只能恐惧地看着自己的灵力被吸收，看着自己的身体肉眼可见的开始衰老。

    须臾后，他心里开始苦笑。

    不愧是先天灵宝，没想到自己最后的结局是这样的。

    就在他闭眼准备迎接死亡的时候，身体猛然被一股大力甩开。

    等他再睁开眼的时候，面前是洛靳的脸。

    洛靳将一瓶丹药放在他的面前，又拿了一个储物袋。
content_en:
"Hu San, she is just a mortal. All her internal organs are destroyed, and all the muscles and veins in her body are severed. She cannot be saved."

    "You still have something to do, right?"

    "Yes, but the price is huge and you can't afford it."

    "..."

    So, is she going to die again?

    How many times has this happened?

    The fourth time? Or the fifth time?

    Can't remember clearly.

    This life is also very tiring, otherwise I will die like this.

    She stopped struggling and let herself fall into the boundless darkness.

    Nothingness, coldness, depression...

    It was like being stuffed into a deep well, or like being stuffed into an ice cellar.

    The body slowly became stiff and unable to move.

    Suddenly, a beam of light fell from above her head.

    She tried to raise her head and squinted her eyes.

    The light was so dazzling that she couldn't see it clearly, but she subconsciously stretched out her hand.

    Her fingertips touched a piece of softness, and she grabbed it almost instinctively.

    Warm and scorching!

    Like a burning flame, it breaks through the fingertips and penetrates into the body.

    It hurts!

    The huge pain overshadowed the coldness, numbness, and the brief warmth, and even drove away her decadence and death wish.

    The light above his head fell suddenly, accompanied by the scorching heat that rushed into his body, like knives and axes passing through his limbs and bones.

    She opened her mouth to cry out the pain, but found that she couldn't make a sound.

    Like a drowning man, watching himself being swallowed in vain.

    But inside the wooden house, Hu San was filled with horror.

    Taoyao was suspended in mid-air, and pink light fell from above. After completely covering Gu Niannian's body, it slowly shrank and finally turned into a pink cocoon of light.

    The surrounding spiritual energy seemed to have received a summons, rushing towards the light cocoon and sinking into it.

    In just a few breaths, all the spiritual energy within a five-mile radius had been absorbed.

    Hu San's eyebrows twitched, and when he realized something was wrong and wanted to leave, it was already too late.

    A beam of light flew out from Taoyao's sword, locked directly on Hu San, and dragged him to the light cocoon.

    The next second, the spiritual energy in his body seemed to have been opened through a huge hole and poured out.

    Hu San could not struggle, and could only watch in horror as his spiritual power was absorbed, and as his body began to age visibly to the naked eye.

    After a while, he began to smile bitterly in his heart.

    As expected of an innate spiritual treasure, I didn’t expect that my final ending would be like this.

    Just when he closed his eyes and prepared to face death, his body was suddenly thrown away by a strong force.

    When he opened his eyes again, Luo Jin's face was in front of him.

    Luo Jin placed a bottle of elixir in front of him and took out a storage bag.
